conbody.p: When the dedicated road mainline has a curved section, the vehicle will automatically decelerate according to the curvature to maintain a safe speed while passing through the curved section. After the curved section, it will continue at the set speed of Smart Cruise Control.

note.p: The timing of deceleration initiation depends on the vehicle’s speed and the curvature of the road. The higher the driving speed, the sooner the deceleration initiates.
